note: TEST-ONLY statement templates for the s10_unseen D2 proof. The run-bound fields (`challenge_b64`, `issued_at`) and the identity fields (`id_set_digest`, `observed_unique`, computed from the staged ids of the family by the independent reference digest in the spec) are filled at test time; everything else is fixed here. `signer` names the key in signer-test-key.json: `source` is the manifest verifier, `observer` stands in for an extension-held key and is never a verifier.
